title: Your AI has no memory of why it did that. Ours does.
hook: Your AI cannot tell you why it did that. Ours keeps the receipts.
thesis: Most AI tools give you confident answers with no paper trail, so when they are wrong nobody can find out why. PING is built the other way: every claim carries its source, every action carries its authorization, and important behavior can be replayed and explained after the fact. The demo version of this post is simple: ask a question, then show the evidence underneath the answer.

verified: PING treats truth in layers (source truth, derived truth, presented truth, evidence) that must never silently collapse into each other (SOUL.md principles 9-13, via SYSTEMS.md section 1).
Failures have typed semantics: an empty answer is never allowed to hide an infrastructure failure (SOUL.md principle 11).
inferred: Most businesses will pay for this kind of auditability in their AI systems.

approval_gate: Nolan approves every exact post. Silence is not approval.
